$comment: C17.2 F — BUNDLED THIRD-PARTY STACK of @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64.
This package ships ONE prebuilt shared library that statically bundles roughly thirty
third-party libraries. C17 recorded only the package-level LGPL-3.0-or-later declaration,
so every bundled library's own terms — MPL, BSD, MIT, zlib, IJG, the AOM patent grant,
and the fontconfig, freetype, libpng and libtiff licences — went unrecorded, along with
Component versions come from the shipped versions.json; the component LIST and its terms
come from the shipped README table. Both are bound by digest below. Prose terms are mapped
to SPDX through a code-owned table, and any term the table does not cover FAILS CLOSED
rather than being guessed — a licence is not something to infer.
These libraries are deliberately NOT added to the C16 npm SBOM: they are not npm
components and the SBOM describes the npm closure. They are a separate C17 legal
subcomponent inventory, which is what the obligations actually attach to.

build_recipe.note: The immutable commit for this tag is recorded in commit_binding below and is what the source offer resolves to; a tag alone is mutable.

commit_binding.why: A tag is mutable; the commit is not. The source offer resolves to this commit, so a recipient obtains the exact recipe this binary was built from even if the tag moves.

bundled_components.name: cairo
bundled_components.licence_note: cairo offers every implementation file under LGPL-2.1 OR MPL-1.1 (its COPYING); sharp-libvips states it is used under MPL 1.1, so that is the licence applied

bundled_components.name: mozjpeg
bundled_components.licence_note: mozjpeg combines zlib, IJG and BSD-3-Clause terms

limits: Component identity is taken from what the package itself ships. This inventory does not independently rebuild the binary and cannot prove which code paths were compiled in.
Not legal advice. Phase 0 is LOCAL-ONLY under EXC-P0-004 and distributes nothing.

source_offers.obligation: weak-copyleft source offer (LGPL relinking / MPL per-file source)
obtain: The exact version bundled is recorded as 1.18.6 in the shipped versions.json.
Upstream source: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/cairo/cairo
The build recipe that pins and compiles it is sharp-libvips at commit ebb95f8add54eee8bed840e3fb587e4cbec857d7, directory npm/linux-x64.
source_offers.relinking: MPL-1.1 obliges source for MODIFIED files (§3.2): the recipe above builds cairo 1.18.6 from its unmodified release with build options only, so no Covered Code file is modified and the upstream source above satisfies it. Under §3.6 the Executable form may be distributed only with a notice that the Source Code is available under MPL-1.1 and of how and where: this is that notice. The Source Code of cairo 1.18.6, the Covered Code in this binary, is available under the terms of the Mozilla Public License 1.1 from the upstream named above, and is reproduced exactly by the recipe at the commit above.

aom_patent_grant.note: The Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0 accompanies aom's BSD-2-Clause grant. SPDX publishes no identifier for it, so no canonical text is vendored and the licence text obligation is discharged by the upstream document named below rather than by a pinned SPDX text. Recorded explicitly instead of being silently dropped.
